data.text: Hi there! I am Bunny - the rabbit! Today, I am here to help you learn more about your health, food, clothes and other elements of your day to day social life. To proceed, just click any of the units on the screen!
Cleaning our body keeps us healthy.
We should brush our teeth in the morning and at night.
We should take a bath or shower every day.
We should wash our hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.
